mapper.select: select reqeut_id as reqeutId, work_id as workId, count(*) as num, 1 as handleType from dws_voc2_batch_push_record where status!='0' and reqeut_id!='-1' AND work_id =#{workId} group by reqeut_id, work_id UNION ALL select reqeut_id as reqeutId, work_id as workId, count(*) as num, 0 as handleType from dws_voc2_batch_push_record where reqeut_id!='-1' AND work_id =#{workId} group by reqeut_id, work_id
